comparisons.title: Thompson’s group T has quadratic Dehn function

source_locator.theorem: TheoremA, original binary Thompson groupT only
source_locator.selected_scope: For the groupT of orientation-preserving dyadic piecewise-linear circle homeomorphisms with slopes integral powers of2, the Dehn function of a finite presentation is equivalent to N squared in the precise coarse comparison of Section2. One primary count; generalized Higman–Thompson family TheoremB, T_(n, r) speculation, V, normal-form/support variants are unselected.
source_locator.scope_warning: Proposition4.3 states the quadratic filling criterion; the nonhyperbolic lower-bound context and published subquadratic gap theorem are explicitly retained on original1. We rely on the source’s full new upper construction, not a false claim that every quadratic upper-bound group has an exact quadratic lower bound. Original general-family indices in unselected Section5 are not repaired.

comparisons.comparison: Quadratic Dehn function for the circle group T; a filling inequality, not classification of the interval groups F_n cobounded hyperbolic actions.

comparisons.title: Non-strong ergodicity of canonical actions of the Thompson groups
comparisons.comparison: Amenable étale groupoid implies Borel-amenable equivalence relation; a measure/groupoid claim, not the hyperbolic-action poset.

comparisons.title: Tree Pairs for Algebraic Bieri-Strebel Groups
comparisons.comparison: Obstruction to tree-pair representation for algebraic Bieri–Strebel groups; different objects and conclusion from F_n confining-subset elimination.

comparisons.title: On subgroups of Brin-Thompson groups $nV$
comparisons.comparison: Embedding a subgroup into a Brin–Thompson group; no hyperbolic-action classification.

comparisons.title: Relative invariant subalgebra rigidity for Thompson's group $F$
comparisons.comparison: Von Neumann algebra L(F) boundary-support lemma for relative invariant subalgebras; not a classification of cobounded hyperbolic actions.

comparisons.title: The one-point Schreier Poisson boundary of Thompson's group $F$
comparisons.comparison: No-holding trace of a Schreier random walk as a reversible tree kernel; stochastic boundary data, not all cobounded hyperbolic actions.

comparisons.comparison: Finite-window Cayley-graph retention/density optimization; not the coarse-equivariant domination poset or character elimination.
